unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Several figures report bar/curve values graphically without a machine-readable table; exact bar heights were not fabricated. Text-supported EC50, approximate, qualitative, and toxicity values were retained with figure locators.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Does not block obtainable-only publication-grade acceptance because source-supported exact values and claims needed for worker-2/4/6 gates are recorded, while exact figure-only bar heights remain a caution.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local supplementary material is a PDF of Supporting Figures S1-S9; no spreadsheet or structured supplementary activity table exists in the local packet.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking; supplement figures provide context only and do not add row-level activity tables beyond XML/PDF figure claims.
